14.t: SELF TEST
Self Test is entered by switching the Self-Test switch on the Coin Door. All memory is cleared & the high score table will be RE INITIALIZED. Step I. 1.
NOTES: RAM TEST
The Games 2 testable 2114's are tested. ANY Ram error will abort the test, thus if the first Ram Tests bad, an error in the second Ram will not show.

If the test passes, RAM OK is displayed on screen. If a beep is heard (NOT a steady tone), a Ram error occured in the chip at F4. If 2 beeps are heard, then the chip at E4 is bad. If this chip is bad, the chip at F4 will not be tested. The 2 beeps will be one high freq., one low.
1. This Test assumes POKEY sounds to be working.
2. If the RAM test fails ALL other tests are invalid.
3. If the RAM test fails, all screen info. is invalid.
Step II. ROM TEST (PROM TEST) This Test will check the program memory in 2K intervals:

NOTES: If all ROM/PROM's verify OK, the words ROM OK will appear on the screen next to the words RAM OK. If one or more bad ROM/PROM's are detected, the word ROM followed by ONE or more letters will appear on the screen. following table show which chip the error occured:
LETTER   Ic #   ADDRESS   NOTES
c   gil   6000-67FF   2
D   H/F 1   6800-6FFF   1
F   Dil   7800-7FFF   1
1. This chip must be good to complete tests.
2. The tests will run with this chip bad. However, messages "ROM" & "RAM OK" may not appear correctly or may not appear at all.
3. I£ this chip is bad, the test is valid only through Step 3 and may not continue.

Step III. COLOR BARS, CHARACTER PROM, TONE TEST 1. After the ROM test completes, a set of color Bars will display. Just bellow this will be a 2 line DISPLAY of characters. The Characters will be "HILIGHTED" by bands of color. A Tone will come on and will continue to sound until any switch is pressed.
